classification: Prospective emulator predictions, no hardware timing collected

manifest.preparation: A0 wrapper sets IQBEN, rewrites one identical halfword in each of eight code lines, then reads back the final word before sampling the timer; no assumption that IQBEN toggling flushes buffers
manifest.timed_wrapper: Owned A0 code, parameters and stack; direct high/low/high timer reads; no syscall or external stack access inside interval

interpretation: Each interval includes the identical call/return, prologue and timer boundary. Short runs expose startup/exit cost; raw whole-interval timing remains the comparison metric.
